data.one_liner: Allows Flutter desktop applications to perceive window activation state.
data.what_it_does: Allows your Flutter desktop application to perceive whether the window is activated. Provides a ValueListenable to check and listen to window active/inactive events.
use_when: You need to know when your Flutter desktop app window is focused or activated.
You want to pause or resume tasks based on desktop window focus.
avoid_when: You are building strictly for mobile or web platforms.
You need complex window management features beyond checking activation.
strengths: Supports multiple desktop platforms (Windows, macOS, Linux).
weaknesses: Limited to window activation state perception.
No documentation on advanced window management features.
data.setup_notes: Add desktop_lifecycle to your pubspec.yaml and use DesktopLifecycle.instance.isActive.
